description: The Storytime song video compositor: a Remotion project that makes the song videos of a week (classroom 1080p, phone 720p, poster, karaoke cut) from the week package (song.lines, song.times, song.audio) and the Forge PNG renders.
deviation_notes: Decision of Daniel with Storytime, 2026-10-22: cut-out animation from Forge PNG renders, composited at Workbooks (Remotion), no Forge animation clips. Video spec corrected by Storytime the same day; output files and schema keys asked by Monorepo for the QR page (target 2026-11-20). Final videos with Forge art by 2026-11-25 for the 2026-12-01 release.
